Australia and Egypt prepare for FIFA World Cup match

The Australian and Egyptian national football teams are set to compete in a FIFA World Cup match. The focus is on the availability of Egypt's star player, Mo Salah, who is reportedly expected to play despite an injury. Australia's coach expressed confidence in his team's ability to achieve a historic result.
